Name: Pole Barns
Text: You can immediately build up to 3 stables at no cost.
Author: oxmond

Name: Renovation Materials
Text: Immediately renovate to clay at no cost.
Author: luki

Name: Tea Time
Text: Immediately return your person on the "Grain Utilization" action space home; you can place it again later this round.
Author: beso

Name: Thunderbolt
Text: Immediately remove all grain from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 wood for each grain you just removed.
Author: beso

Name: Night Loot
Text: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Recount
Text: You immediately get 1 building resource of each type of which you have 4 or more resources in your supply already.
Author: guy

Name: Pumpernickel
Text: You immediately get 4 food.
Author: tamos

Name: Farmers Market
Text: You immediately get 1 vegetable.

Name: Bartering Hut
Text: Up to two times: Immediately spend any 2/3/4 building resources for 1 sheep/wild boar/cattle from the general supply.

Name: Straw Hat
Text: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the "Farmland" action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 food.
Author: kulbrot

Name: Petting Zoo
Text: As long as you have a pasture orthogonally adjacent to your house, you can keep animals of any type on this card, up to the number of rooms in your house.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Animal Bedding
Text: You can keep 1 additional animal in each of your unfenced stables, and 2 additional animals in each pasture with stable.
Author: keith

Name: Stone House Reconstruction
Text: At any time, you can renovate your clay house to a stone house withot placing a person. (You must pay the normal renovation cost.)
Author: pain

Name: Wood Saw
Text: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a "Build Rooms" action.
Author: chris

Name: Nail Basket
Text: Each time after you use a wood accumulation space, you can place 1 stone from your supply on that space (for the next visitor) to take a “Build Fences” action.
Author: beso

Name: Briar Hedge
Text: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Skimmer Plow
Text: Each time you use the "Farmland" or "Cultivation" action space, you can plow 2 fields instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each field you sow.
Author: beso

Name: Seed Almanac
Text: Each time after you play a minor improvement after this one, you can pay 1 food to plow 1 field.
Author: nwoll

Name: Ox Goad
Text: Each time after you use the "Cattle Market" accumulation space, you can pay 2 food to plow 1 field.
Author: beso

Name: Iron Hoe
Text: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the "Grain Seeds" and "Vegetable Seeds" action spaces, you can plow 1 field.
Author: chris

Name: Sheep Rug
Text: You can use any "Wish for Children" action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.
Author: beso

Name: Guest Room
Text: Immediately place any amount of food from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 food from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.
Author: nwoll

Name: Apiary
Text: At the end of each work phase, you can sow exactly 1 crop on 1 field.
Author: beso

Name: Ambition
Text: Each time you get a "Minor Improvement" action on an action space, you can build a major improvement instead of playing a minor one.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Bumper Crop
Text: When you play this card, immediately play the field phase of the harvest on your farmyard only.
Author: ss

Name: Sundial
Text: At the end of the work phases in rounds 7 and 9, you can take a "Sow" action without placing a person.
Author: oxmond

Name: Piggy Bank
Text: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 food on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 food from this to build a major improvement at no cost.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Bookmark
Text: Add 3 to the current round and mark the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
Author: beso

Name: Heirloom
Text: This card has no additional effect.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Child's Toy
Text: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 food (instead of 1).
Author: beso

Name: Upholstery
Text: Each time you build or play an improvement after this one, you can place 1 reed on this card, irretrievably, to get 1 bonus point, up to the number of rooms in your house.
Author: cunning

Name: Nave
Text: During scoring, you get 1 bonus point for each of the 5 columns of your farmyard board containing at least one room.
Author: luki

Name: Beaver Colony
Text: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get reed from an action space, you get 1 bonus point.
Author: superg

Name: Land Register
Text: During scoring, if your farm has no unused spaces, you get 2 bonus points.
Author: luki

Name: Misanthropy
Text: During scoring, if you have exactly 4/3/2 people, you get 2/3/5 bonus points.
Author: pm_ballard

Name: Herbal Garden
Text: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.
Author: chris

Name: Ox Skull
Text: During scoring, if you have no cattle, you get 3 bonus points.
Author: tamos

Name: Rod Collection
Text: Each time you use "Fishing", you can place up to 2 wood on this card, irretrievably. During scoring, each such wood is worth 1 bonus point, except the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.
Author: superg

Name: Paintbrush
Text: Each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 clay for your choice of 2 food or 1 bonus point.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Bee Statue
Text: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 vegetable, 1 stone, 1 grain, 1 stone, 1 grain on this card. Each time you use the "Day Laborer" action space, you get the top good.
Author: vancoch

Name: Muddy Waters
Text: Alternate placing 1 food and 1 clay on each remaining even-numbered round space, starting with food. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
Author: vancoch

Name: Water Gully
Text: Place 1 cattle, 1 grain, and 1 cattle on the next 3 round spaces (in that order). At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Barn Cats
Text: If you have 1/2/3/4 stables, place 1 food on each of the next 2/3/4/5 remaining round spaces . At the start of these rounds, you get the food.
Author: beso

Name: Fodder Beets
Text: Place 1 food on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the food.
Author: letsdance

Name: Fruit Ladder
Text: Place 1 food on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the food.
Author: luki

Name: Waterlily Pond
Text: Place 1 food on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the food.
Author: hako

Name: Syrup Tap
Text: Each time you get at least 1 wood from an action space, place 1 food on the next round space. At the start of that round, you get the food.
Author: kulbrot

Name: Town Hall
Text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, if you live in a clay or stone house, you get 1 or 2 food, respectively.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Twibil
Text: Each time after any player (including you) builds at least 1 wood room, you get 1 food.
Author: chriss

Name: Wild Greens
Text: Each time you sow, you get 1 food for every different type of good that you sow.
Author: luki

Name: Whale Oil
Text: Each time you use "Fishing", place 1 food from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get food equal to the amount on this card.
Author: chriss

Name: Cubbyhole
Text: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 food from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get food equal to the amount on this card.
Author: minnie

Name: Boar Spear
Text: Each time you get wild boar outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 food each.
Author: tamos

Name: Contraband
Text: Each time you play or build an improvement after this, you can pay 1 additional building resource of a type in the printed cost (of the new card) to get 3 food.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Stone Weir
Text: Each time you use the "Fishing" accumulation space, if there are 0/1/2/3 food on the space, you get an additional 4/3/2/1 food from the general supply.
Author: beso

Name: Roman Pot
Text: Place 4 food from the general supply on this card. At the start of each work phase, if you are the last player in turn order, move 1 food from this card to your supply.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Cheese Fondue
Text: Each time you bake at least 1 grain into bread, you get 1 additional food if you have at least 1 sheep and 1 additional food if you have at least 1 cattle.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Lunchtime Beer
Text: At the start of each harvest, you can choose to skip the field and breeding phase and get exactly 1 food instead.
Author: chris

Name: Comb and Cutter
Text: Each time you use the "Day Laborer" action space, you get 1 additional food for each sheep on the "Sheep Market" accumulation space, up to a maximum of 4 additional food.
Author: guy

Name: Working Gloves
Text: When you play this card, you get 1 food. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can pay 1 building resource of your choice in place of (up to) 2 food.
Author: letsdance

Name: Raised Bed
Text: At the start of each harvest, you get 4 food.
Author: beso

Name: Sour Dough
Text: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a "Bake Bread" action instead.
Author: chris

Name: Iron Oven
Text: "Bake Bread" action: [1 grain -(1×)-> 6 food] When you play this card, you can immediately take a "Bake Bread" action.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Simple Oven
Text: "Bake Bread" action: [1 grain -(1×)-> 3 food] When you play this card, you can immediately take a "Bake Bread" action.
Author: beso

Name: Almsbag
Text: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 grain for every 2 completed rounds.
Author: luki

Name: Barn Shed
Text: Each time another player (or, in a solo game, you) uses the "Forest" accumulation space, you get 1 grain.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Grain Bag
Text: Each time you use the "Grain Seeds" action space, you get 1 additional grain for each <BAKE> improvement you have.
Author: beso

Name: Cherry Orchard
Text: This card is a field on which you can only sow and harvest wood as you would grain. Each time you harvest the last wood from this card, you also get 1 vegetable.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Melon Patch
Text: This card is a field that can only grow vegetables. Each time you harvest the last vegetable from this card, you can plow 1 field.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Crop Rotation Field
Text: This card is a field. Each time you remove the last grain or vegetable from this card, you can immediately sow vegetable or grain on this card, respectively.
Author: chris

Name: Cow Patty
Text: Each time you sow in a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a pasture, you can place 1 additional good of the planted type in it.
Author: chriss

Name: Artichoke Field
Text: This card is a field. During the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 1 good from this card, you also get 1 food.
Author: minnie

Name: Scythe
Text: During the field phase of each harvest, you can select exactly one of your fields and harvest all the goods planted in it.
Author: cunning

Name: Ash Trees
Text: When you play this card, immediately place (up to) 5 fences from your supply on it. When building fences, fences taken from this card cost you nothing.
Author: beso

Name: Stone Axe
Text: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can return 1 stone to the general supply to get an additional 3 wood.
Author: beso

Name: Lumber Pile
Text: When you play this card, you can immediately return up to 3 stables from your farmyard board to your supply and get 3 wood for each.
Author: henrysunset

Name: Mattock
Text: Each time you get reed and/or stone from an action space, you get 1 additional clay.
Author: chris

Name: Sleight of Hand
Text: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange up to 4 building resources for an equal number of other building resources.
Author: beso

Name: Field Spade
Text: Each time after you sow in at least 1 field, you get 1 stone.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Rock Garden
Text: You can only plant stone on this card. Plant as though it were 3 fields, but it is considered 1 field. Sow and harvest stone on this card as you would vegetables.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Alchemists Lab
Text: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 food.
Author: oxmond

Name: Profiteering
Text: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 food. Each time you use the "Day Laborer" action space, you can exchange 1 building resource for another building resource.
Author: chris

Name: Shepherd's Whistle
Text: At the start of the breeding phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1 unfenced stable without animal, you get 1 sheep.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Dolly's Mother
Text: You only require 1 sheep to breed sheep during the breeding phase of a harvest. This card can hold 1 sheep.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Master Tanner
Text: For each wild boar or cattle you turn into food, you can place 1 of that food on this card. Once its food equals your number of rooms, this card provides room for 1 person.
Author: maninteitz

Name: Pen Builder
Text: At any time, you can place wood from your supply on this card, irretrievably. You can keep twice as many animals of any type on this card as there is wood on it.
Author: nwoll

Name: Master Renovator
Text: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a "Renovation" action without placing a person and pay 1 building resource of your choice less.
Author: really_unknow4

Name: Master Fencer
Text: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 2 or 3 wood to build up to 3 or 4 fences, respectively.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Stallwright
Text: After you play your 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th occupation (including this one), you can build 1 stable at no cost.
Author: beso

Name: Dung Collector
Text: Each time you breed 2 or more newborn animals, you can pay 1 food to plow 1 field.
Author: power_sharpner

Name: Plow Builder
Text: You can build the Joinery when taking a "Minor Improvement" action. If you use the Joinery (or an upgrade thereof) during the harvest, you can pay 1 food to plow 1 field.
Author: chris

Name: Field Doctor
Text: Once this game, if you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms surrounded by 4 field tiles, you can use aby "Family Growth" action space even without room.
Author: chris

Name: Motivator
Text: On your first turn each round, if you have no unused farmyard spaces, you can place a person from your supply.
Author: chris

Name: Prophet
Text: When you play this card, immediately take a "Renovation" action. Afterward, you can take a "Build Fences" action. (Both actions require their usual cost.)
Author: mattthelesser

Name: Miller
Text: You can immediately build a <BAKE> improvement by paying its cost. Each time another player uses the "Grain Seeds" action space, you can take a “Bake Bread” action.
Author: tom

Name: Elder
Text: You can play this card at the start of the work phase of round 1 without placing a person. (This card has no effect other than counting as a played occupation.)
Author: mattthelesser

Name: Beneficiary
Text: If this is your 3rd occupation, you can immediately play another occupation for an occupation cost of 1 food and/or play 1 minor improvement by paying its cost.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Prodigy
Text: If this is your 1st occupation, you immediately get 1 bonus point for each improvement you have. (This will not apply to improvements played after this card.)
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Uncaring Parents
Text: At the end of each harvest, if you live in a stone house, you get 1 bonus point.
Author: wulf684

Name: Museum Caretaker
Text: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 wood, 1 clay, 1 reed, 1 stone, 1 grain, and 1 vegetable in your supply, you get 1 bonus point.
Author: kosherdill

Name: Blighter
Text: When you play this, you get 1 bonus point for each complete stage left to play. You may not play any more occupations.
Author: luki

Name: Acquirer
Text: At the start of each round, you may pay food equal to the number of people you have to buy 1 good of your choice from the general supply.
Author: grummelbaum

Name: Wolf
Text: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 clay, 1 wood, and 1 grain on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 wild boar.
Author: oxmond

Name: Spice Trader
Text: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 3 vegetables on the space for round 11. At the start of that round, you get the vegetables.
Author: snapper

Name: Pioneer
Text: When you play this card and each time before you use the most recent action space card, you get 1 building resource of your choice and 1 food.
Author: luki

Name: Emergency Seller
Text:
When you play this card, you can immediately turn as many building resources into food as you have people:
[wood]/[clay] -> 2 [food]
[reed]/[stone] -> 3 [food]
Author: nwoll

Name: Land Surveyor
Text: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 2/4/6/7 fields, you get 1/2/3/4 food.
Author: chris

Name: Blackberry Farmer
Text: Each time you build fences, place 1 food on each remaining round space, up to the number of fences just built. At the start of these rounds, you get the food.
Author: superg

Name: Braid Maker
Text: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 reed for 2 food. You can build the Basket Maker's Workshop for 1 reed and 1 stone even when taking a "Minor Impr." action.
Author: agentricola

Name: Dentist
Text: At the start of each harvest, you can place 1 wood from your supply on this card, irretrievably. In each feeding phase, you get 1 food for each wood on this card.
Author: chris

Name: Recluse
Text: As long as you have no minor improvements in front of you, you get 1 food at the start of each round and 1 wood at the start of each harvest.
Author: letsdance

Name: Grain Thief
Text: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 grain from the general supply instead.
Author: letsdance

Name: Godmother
Text: Each time you take a "Family Growth" action, you also get 1 vegetable.
Author: luki

Name: Shed Builder
Text: When you build your 1st and 2nd stable, you get 1 grain. When you build your 3rd and 4th stable, you get 1 vegetable. (This does not apply to stables you have already built.)
Author: nwoll

Name: Seed Servant
Text: Each time after you use the "Grain Seeds" or "Vegetable Seeds" action space, you can take a "Bake bread" or "Sow" action, respectively.
Author: beso

Name: Fir Cutter
Text: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 food. Each time after you use an animal accumulation space with your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person, you get 1/1/2/2/3 wood.
Author: beso

Name: Pipe Smoker
Text: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 1 grain field, you get 2 wood.
Author: tom

Name: Kindling Gatherer
Text: Each time you get food from an action space, you get 1 additional wood.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Land Heir
Text: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 4 wood and 4 clay on the space for round 9. At the start of this round, you get the resources.
Author: oxmond

Name: Scrap Collector
Text: Alternate placing 1 wood and 1 clay on each of the next 6 round spaces, starting with wood. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective resource.
Author: beso

Name: Hill Cultivator
Text: Each time you use the "Grain Seeds" or "Vegetable Seeds" action space, you also get 2 or 3 clay, respectively.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Cottar
Text: Each time you play or build an improvement, you get your choice of 1 wood or 1 clay immediately after paying its cost.
Author: chris

Name: Resource Hoarder
Text: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: Stone, Clay, Stone, Reed, Wood, Clay)
Author: inoshishi

Name: Mayor Candidate
Text: You immediately get 2 wood and 2 stone. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each wood and each stone in your supply. You can no longer discard wood or stone.
Author: oxmond

Name: Delayed Wayfarer
Text: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 building resource of your choice and, once all people have been placed this round, you can place a person from your supply.
Author: mattthelesser

Name: Tax Collector
Text: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you get your choice of 2 wood, 2 clay, 1 reed, or 1 stone.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Diligent Farmer
Text: When you play this card, if you would score the maximum 4 points in 3 scoring categories (including fenced stables), you can extend your house by 1 room at no cost.
Author: shiunyuans

Name: Saddler
Text: Each time after you build a major improvement, you can pay 1 food to plow 1 field.
Author: beso

Name: Imitator
Text: If you have a person on the "Day Laborer" action space, you can use non-accumulating round 1-9 action spaces even if they are occupied.
Author: nwoll

Name: Overachiever
Text: Each time you use a "Wish for Children" action space, you can build or play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost less 1 resource of your choice.
Author: chris

Name: Market Master
Text: Immediately after each time you place your last person in a round on the "Traveling Players" accumulation space, you can play 1 occupation for an occupation cost of 1 food.
Author: beso

Name: Shearer
Text: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/4/7 sheep, you get 1/2/3 food. (Keep the sheep.) During scoring, you get 1 bonus point for every 3 sheep.
Author: maninteitz

Name: Champion Breeder
Text: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus points, respectively.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Omnifarmer
Text: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, exchange 2/3/4/5 different goods on this for 3/5/7/9 bonus points.
Author: apeirox

Name: Pickler
Text: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 wood. During scoring, each player with the most total vegetables gets 3 bonus points.
Author: chris

Name: Animal Husbandry Worker
Text: If there are 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 wood and a "Build Fences" action. During scoring, each player with the most pastures gets 2 bonus points.
Author: really_unknow4

Name: Flax Farmer
Text: Each time you use the "Reed Bank" accumulation space, you also get 1 grain. Each time you use the "Grain Seeds" action space, you also get 1 reed.
Author: beso

Name: Livestock Expert
Text: If you play this card in round 11 or before, choose an animal type: You immediately get a number of animals of that type equal to the number you already have on your farm.
Author: luki

Name: Bunny Breeder
Text: Select a future round space, subtract the number of the current round from it, and place this many food on that space. At the start of that round, you get the food.
Author: barbarossa89

Name: Carter
Text: Next round, each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you also get 1 food for each building resource that you take from the space.
Author: oxmond

Name: Vegetable Vendor
Text: Each time you use the "Major Improvement" or "Vegetable Seeds" action space, you also get 1 vegetable or a "Major or Minor Improvement" action, respectively.
Author: ss

Name: Smuggler
Text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange up to 2 goods as follows: [1 Wood => 1 Grain] or [1 Grain => 1 Stone]
Author: chriss

Name: Hewer
Text: From round 3 on, at the end of each work phase in which all clay accumulation spaces are unoccupied, you get 1 stone and 1 food.
Author: azwandahlan

Name: Wares Salesman
Text: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a card that lets them turn building resources into food, you get exactly 1 corresponding building resource and 1 reed.
Author: mattthelesser

Name: Parvenu
Text: If you play this card in round 7 or before, immediately double the amount of clay or reed in your supply.
Author: oxmond

Name: Reseller
Text: Once this game, immediately after playing or building an improvement, you can choose to get its printed cost from the general supply.
Author: luki

Name: Animal Driver
Text: At the start of each harvest, if you have 1/2/3+ fenced stables, you get 1 sheep/wild boar/cattle.
Author: beso

Name: Lazybones
Text: Place (up to) 1 stable each on "Grain Seeds", "Farmland", "Day Laborer", and "Farm Expansion". Build the stable at no cost when another player uses that action space.
Author: cunning

Name: Midnight Fencer
Text: At the start of the last harvest, you can take up to 2 of each other player's unbuilt fences and build them on your farm at no cost. (Your farm can then have over 15 fences.)
Author: cunning

Name: Rock Beater
Text: You can use an action space providing both stone and a different building resource even if it is occupied by another player. Stone rooms cost you 2 stone less.
Author: chris

Name: Delivery Nurse
Text: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can turn a "Family Growth" action into a "Family Growth Even without Room" action.
Author: beso

Name: Bargain Hunter
Text: At the start of each round, you can place 1 food from your supply on the "Traveling Players" accumulation space to play a minor improvement by paying its cost.
Author: nwoll

Name: Stone Sculptor
Text: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 stone for 1 bonus point and 1 food.
Author: keith

Name: Margrave
Text: Once you live in a stone house, you get 2 food each time any player (including you) renovates and, during scoring, 1 bonus point for each wood house and clay house.
Author: guy

Name: Visionary
Text: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 stone, 1 vegetable, and 2 wild boar. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.
Author: chris

Name: Claypit Owner
Text: Each time another player plays or builds an improvement with a printed clay cost, you get 1 food and 1 clay.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Usufructuary
Text: When you play this card as your first occupation, you immediately get 1 food for every other occupation in play (by any player), up to a maximum of 7 food.
Author: tamos

Name: Stone Custodian
Text: At the end of each work phase, you get 1 food for each stone accumulation space with stone on it.
Author: agentricola

Name: Old Miser
Text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less food. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.
Author: keith

Name: Kelp Gatherer
Text: Each time another player uses the "Fishing" accumulation space, they get 1 additional food and you get 1 vegetable.
Author: luki

Name: Elder Baker
Text: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 grain. You can build the "Stone Oven" major improvement even when taking a "Minor Improvement" action.
Author: nwoll

Name: Entrepreneur
Text: At the start of each round, you can move 1 food to this card or discard 1 food from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.
Author: inoshishi

Name: Patroness
Text: Each time after you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
Author: beso

Name: Mountain Plowman
Text: Each time you plow at least 1 field, you get 1 sheep for each field that you just plowed.
Author: nwoll

Name: Master Huntsman
Text: When you play this card and each time you build a major improvement, you get 1 wild boar.
Author: nwoll

Name: Roastmaster
Text: Each time you use the "Traveling Players" or "Fishing" accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 food from that space to the other to get 1 cattle.
Author: joeknapp38

Name: Dairy Crier
Text: When you play this card, each player (including you) can choose to get 2 sheep or 2 food; you also get 1 cattle.
Author: oxmond

Name: Animal Tamer's Apprentice
